brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a "who's on first"-style IETF RFC generator for protocol specs that are as confusing as possible to interpret, despite rigorous use of RFC 2119 and ASD-STE100 standard english
note: built rfcwho.bisks.net: an RFC generator where every clause is a real RFC 2119 MUST/SHOULD/MAY and every sentence is ASD-STE100 plain style — the nodes are just named Who, What, and I Don't Know, so rigor buys you zero clarity.
